SYN Flood.description: Massive volume of TCP SYN packets designed to exhaust connection state tables on the target network firewall or server.

Application DoS.description: Attempts to exhaust application resources (e.g., GoldenEye, Slowloris) using targeted requests rather than pure volumetric bandwidth.

Port Scanning.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services listening on remote hosts and local network infrastructure devices.

Brute Force.description: Systematic guessing of passwords, identifiable by uniform connection durations and repetitive request sizes over a single service port.
